responsibility: This header declares the callback-based generic standard I/O dispatch interface for the mc-boot runtime. It defines the input and output procedure record types and exports the read/write entry points plus push/pop/current operations that let clients redirect character streams without depending directly on the underlying IO implementation.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface side of GStdIO: it defines the read/write callback types and declares the generic dispatch and stack-management routines, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStdIO.cc implements the actual callback stacks and redirection behavior.
